CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

5. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

7. Solve for x: x + 7 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 10
   C. 17
   D. 11

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

10. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 55

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 17

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 11

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 40

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

22. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

23. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 0

24. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

27. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37

28. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)

   D. 36

29. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

30. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169
